# A destroyed grid leaves main-thread addon registrations behind

## Context

Ada's defect-note (2026-10-16 15:01Z, while reviewing #19804): a unit probe runs `initVnode()`, sets `mounted = true` and calls `destroy()` in one tick. On dev `3b3b26fff1` this raises an unhandled `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'horizontalScrollbar')` at `ScrollManager.updateDragScrollAddon` (`src/grid/ScrollManager.mjs:286`). I promoted it by triage for v13.3 grid polish, because a source read of the same mechanism shows registrations also outlive every ordinary destroy. Only Ada's probe has been run. Everything else below comes from reading the source; the fix's unit witnesses show it red first.

## The Problem

A grid registers up to six main-thread addons on mount, each through `await Neo.currentWorker.getAddon()`. Two defects follow.

**1. Registrations that resume after destroy.** `Base#destroy` deletes every writable own property except `destroy` and `_id` (`src/core/Base.mjs:534–541`). A grid destroyed before `getAddon` resolves therefore resumes its register arms on a dead instance:
- `ScrollManager`'s `updateDragScrollAddon`, `updateRowScrollPinningAddon`, `updateGridRowHoverSyncAddon` and `updateGridHorizontalScrollSyncAddon` read `me.gridContainer.*` and throw (Ada's receipt). `VerticalScrollbar#addScrollSync` reads `me.parent.view.id` after its await the same way.
- `Container#addResizeObserver` builds its payload from `me.id`, which survives destroy, so it throws nothing: it registers a holder for the destroyed grid. `Container#destroy` has already sent its unregister synchronously (`src/grid/Container.mjs:1106`), so nothing ever removes the late holder.

**2. Registrations no destroy retires.** `Container#destroy` destroys its `scrollManager` and `verticalScrollbar` directly (`Container.mjs:1101–1102`), so neither passes through an unmount. `ScrollManager#destroy` retires only `GridRowScrollPinning` and `GridHorizontalScrollSync` (`ScrollManager.mjs:156–160`). That leaves three registrations behind on every destroy:
- `GridDragScroll`, which is on by default.
- `GridRowHoverSync`, registered when there are locked columns (`Container.mjs:1568`).
- The vertical scrollbar's `ScrollSync`. `VerticalScrollbar` has no `destroy` override.

Each main-thread registration keeps listeners in its addon's `registrations` map. `GridDragScroll` also keeps the grid's body and container elements there (`src/main/addon/GridDragScroll.mjs:379–406`; likewise `GridRowHoverSync.mjs:116–137` and `ScrollSync.mjs:149–184`).

## The Architectural Reality

- Design authority, in two records:
  - The teardown spec's summary: "A grid that goes away must release the native ResizeObserver it caused." (`test/playwright/unit/grid/ResizeObserverTeardown.spec.mjs`)
  - `ScrollManager`'s `mounted_` lifecycle, which unregisters on unmount to prevent leaks. Destroy bypasses unmount, so this lifecycle never sees it.
- The unregister arms are safe after destroy. They need only `me.id`, which `_id` keeps, and the `windowId` argument. `ScrollManager#destroy` already relies on this. The five grid addons' `unregister` methods each ignore an id they do not hold.
- Precedent: `passSizeToBody` returns once the grid is gone, because "`view` resolves nothing once the grid is gone" (`#19661`).
- #19804 rewrites `addResizeObserver` to register `me.view.id` as well, and at its head the same probe throws at that read. Whichever PR lands second keeps the guard through its rebase.

## The Fix

- In the six methods above, each register arm that resumes after `getAddon` skips a destroyed instance (`me.isDestroyed`). Unregister arms are unchanged.
- `ScrollManager#destroy` also retires `GridDragScroll` and `GridRowHoverSync`.
- `VerticalScrollbar` gets a `destroy` that retires its `ScrollSync`.
- No config or API change.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A grid mounted and destroyed in the same tick raises no unhandled rejection.
- [ ] After any destroy, whether of a mounted grid or one racing its mount, every addon registration the grid made has been retired: per addon and id, registers minus unregisters is at most 0. Red on dev for `GridDragScroll`, `ScrollSync` and the late `ResizeObserver` holder.
- [ ] A mounted grid that is still alive registers the same addons as today (positive control).
- [ ] `ResizeObserverTeardown.spec.mjs` stays green.

## Out of Scope

- #19804's own `me.view.id` read; its author carries the guard at rebase.
- The main-thread addons themselves; they unregister correctly when told.
